messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

R&S raw evidence lists an Aerospace & Defense Test context for “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.” [38]
R&S raw evidence describes a “Virtual tester” workflow that spans “implementation → test → debug → validation.” [39]
The R&S CMX500 is described as a Radio Communication Tester and a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution [31].
The CMX500 callbox positioning is to quickly establish a DUT connection and perform RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [1].
The CMX500 callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, RF measurements, and non-signaling verification [15].
The CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI reporting, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [2].
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar-adjacent program, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would fit **after implementation, during test/debug/validation**, as the DUT connectivity, RF measurement, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification station; this combines the R&S workflow evidence with the CMX500 signaling/non-signaling test capabilities. [39][1][2][15]
【推論】The passages do not justify calling the CMX500 a radar tester; they only support cellular/WLAN/NTN/network-emulation and RF verification roles. [1][2][31]

[1] Wiki：CMX500 Callbox（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Randy Schnell
[[Randy Schnell]] 是 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 封面列名的 Business Development Manager，Aerospace & Defense Test。

Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing

Gatehouse Satcom › 與 Rohde & Schwarz 的合作
依 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]]：

- [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] formalized collaboration，以 strengthening validation and testing of [[5G IoT-NTN]] and [[NR-NTN]] technologies。
- 合作目標是將 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 的 5G [[NTN]] software expertise 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] test and measurement capabilities 結合。
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]] gains access to the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，作為共同 further develop advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases 的一部分。
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]] contributes end-to-end NTN test results、technical insight and engineering feedback，協助 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 強化 NTN-focused test capabilities。

| Signal Integrity modeling/testing | IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance | [[Signal Integrity]]、[[Dk-Df]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供 S-parameter、模型格式或驗證流程 |
| Sampling testing | IL、DK/DF、impedance | [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供抽樣頻率、樣本數或允收條件 |
| PL / Process Monitoring | IL、DK/DF、impedance 等流程語境 | [[Process Monitoring]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | PL 未展開；未提供 control limit 或 SPC 指標 |

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

Sharp › unresolved
- 需要擷取 Sharp 5G NTN / LEO terminal 官方新聞稿或技術文件。
- 需要確認 [[MediaTek M80]] 是否實際用於 Sharp trial，以及 trial 的 3GPP release、frequency bands、orbit / satellite operator 與測試結果。
- 需要確認 `2025 H1` trial validation 是否已完成或只是 roadmap。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Program / roadmap 脈絡
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把 private 5G resilience 放入 defense / Future-G roadmap：

| 期間 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 2025–2028 | widespread deployment of 5G tactical networks；mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；hybrid commercial / military networks such as 5G.MIL-style architectures |
| 2028–2032 | 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios replacing multi-radio tactical stacks；early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection and perimeter defense；[[URLLC]] services for autonomy |
| 2032–2035+ | full 6G networks with integrated sensing；AI-native battlefield connectivity；high-precision location sensing and spectrum-aware autonomy |

來源也列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] 與 [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing programs，作為 FHSS 與 5G convergence 的 program examples。

China Mobile Research Institute › 來源中的描述
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]]：

- [[China Mobile Research Institute]] serves as the core research and development institution within [[中國移動]]'s science and technology innovation system。
- 其目標是「building the central research institute for China Mobile's high-quality development and becoming a world-class core engine for science and technology services」。
- 來源列出的 research domains 包含：
  - wireless technologies
  - networks
  - services
  - security
  - [[Internet of Things]]
  - testing
  - think-tank research in strategic markets and industries
  - frontier technologies

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

MediaTek M80 › unresolved
- 需要取得 [[MediaTek]] 官方 [[MediaTek M80]] datasheet、press release 或 product page。
- 需要確認 [[MediaTek M80]] 是否正式支援 [[3GPP Release 19]] NTN，以及支援範圍是 modem、protocol stack、RF、NB-NTN、NR-NTN 或其他。
- 需要確認 [[Sharp]] trial 的日期、終端型號、衛星 operator、frequency band、test setup 與結果。
- 需要確認 `2025 H2` commercial modem mass production 是否為已發生事件、計畫或簡報假設。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing › 重點摘要
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 被描述為 fast-growing satellite communications software company，專長是 [[5G Non-Terrestrial Networks]]。
- 合作焦點是強化 [[5G IoT-NTN]] 與 [[NR-NTN]] 技術的 validation and testing，背景是市場從 specification work 走向 real-world implementation。
- 雙方結合 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 的 5G [[NTN]] software expertise 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 test and measurement capabilities，目標是在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下改善 validation 方法。
- 來源稱 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 取得 [[R&S CMX500]] platform access，作為共同進一步開發 advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases 的一部分。
- 來源稱此合作支援更準確的 satellite radio channel modelling，以及在不同 scenarios 下更 realistic testing of 5G NTN behavior。
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 貢獻 end-to-end NTN test results、technical insight 與 engineering feedback，協助 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 持續強化 NTN-focused test capabilities。
- 預期效益包含 faster validation cycles、earlier identification of system-level issues、stronger test conditions、reducing technical uncertainty 與 accelerating time to market。
- [[Peter Mariager]] 以 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] VP 5G Technology 身分表示，合作有助於更 standardized and repeatable 5G NTN validation。
- [[Christian Dobmeier]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Director of Product Group CMX500 身分表示，合作涵蓋 5G NTN technologies，包括 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] 與 [[LEO]] satellite services，並為未來 [[6G NTN testing and validation]] 奠定基礎。

answer.text:
R&S raw evidence lists an Aerospace & Defense Test context for “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.” [38]
R&S raw evidence describes a “Virtual tester” workflow that spans “implementation → test → debug → validation.” [39]
The R&S CMX500 is described as a Radio Communication Tester and a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution [31].
The CMX500 callbox positioning is to quickly establish a DUT connection and perform RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [1].
The CMX500 callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, RF measurements, and non-signaling verification [15].
The CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI reporting, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [2].
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar-adjacent program, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester would fit **after implementation, during test/debug/validation**, as the DUT connectivity, RF measurement, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification station; this combines the R&S workflow evidence with the CMX500 signaling/non-signaling test capabilities. [39][1][2][15]
【推論】The passages do not justify calling the CMX500 a radar tester; they only support cellular/WLAN/NTN/network-emulation and RF verification roles. [1][2][31]
